newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Tri Polyta calls EGM.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Tri Polyta calls EGM.

text.p: PT Tri Polyta Indonesia said in a statement on Saturday that it was calling an extraordinary general meeting on November 11 to explain certain proposed transactions and get shareholder approval for them.
It said the transactions covered the purchase of propylene and proposed land acquisition.

"The proposed transactions constitute conflict of interest ...and such transactions would require the approval of independent shareholders of the company, representing more than 50 percent of shares owned by the independent shareholders," it said in the statement.
